description: This Java source file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named AnswerController, which manages CRUD operations related to 'Answer' entities associated with questions. It provides endpoints to get answers by question ID, add, update, and delete answers, coordinating with repositories and handling resource-not-found exceptions.

classes.name: AnswerController
classes.description: Spring REST controller handling HTTP requests for 'Answer' entities related to questions, including fetching, creating, updating, and deleting answers.

methods.name: getAnswersByQuestionId
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all answers associated with a specific question ID.

methods.name: addAnswer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new answer to a specific question.

methods.name: updateAnswer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing answer associated with a question.

methods.name: deleteAnswer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove an answer associated with a question.
